newsitem.title: USA: Enron president to resign December 31.
newsitem.headline: Enron president to resign December 31.

text.p: Enron Corp President Richard Kinder is resigning effective December 31, company spokeswoman Carol Hensley said Tuesday.
Kenneth Lay has agreed to a five-year contract extension as chairman and chief executive officer and, effective January 1, will assume the additional position of president, Enron said.
"I am pleased that, after its normal periodic review of senior management, the board asked Rich Kinder, president and chief operating officer, and me to continue in our current roles," Lay said.

"Unfortunately, after much discussion and due consideration of his career objectives, Rich has elected to pursue opportunities beyond Enron rather than continue in the chief operating officer role, which he has held for more than six years."
